text.text: Personal information should stay personal, and that’s why we only collect the minimum necessary info meant to help us improve the experience we deliver to our associates.
We collect the following personal information: name, e-mail address, phone number
We do not correlate personal identification data with non-identifying personal data unless clearly specified at the moment of collection.
We collect the following non-identifying personal information: IP address, cookies, referring URL, browser type, operating system, site usage, and browsing history.
